title: Figure 1: Schematic of the 1972 Freedman-Clauser EPR experiment
description: Line schematic of an entangled-photon polarization correlation setup with a central Ca-OVEN, D2 ARC, lenses and filters, flanked by "POLARIZER 1" and "POLARIZER 2" leading to photomultipliers PM1 and PM2. Electronics below include discriminators (DISC.), AMP, DELAY, two COINC. units, a T.A.C. and P.H.A. The caption reads "Figure 1. Schematic of the 1972 Freedman-Clauser Experiment (Reference 1)."
